error[ZBX-E0710]: the state volume's trash has expired
  while  restoring the state volume pgdata
  cause  pgdata went to the trash more than 7 days ago, and its trash has
         expired
  volume pgdata
  trash  pgdata@1759999880
  fix    copy its files out by hand first (zbx explain E0710)
  more   zbx explain E0710
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0710.html
